title: Édith Piaf's birth chart
metaDescription: Édith Piaf's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.5° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Venus and Jupiter sit 0.3° from an exact sextile — near enough that the tradition reads taste and expansion as a single working part. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 26.5° Sagittarius. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by the Sun in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 28.5° Sagittarius; Venus stands at 20.9° Capricorn; Mars stands at 28.9° Leo. The tradition reads a mind that decides at speaking speed from Mercury, taste for the substantial and the lasting from Venus, drive that ignites on contact from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Venus and Jupiter — a sextile holding at 0.3°. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it. Behind it, Mercury trine Mars at 0.4°, and the Sun conjunction Mercury at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has three entries for this chart. Mercury in Sagittarius at 28.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Pisces at 20.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Cancer at 14.3° is in detriment. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 fire, 3 water, 1 earth, 1 air by element and 3 mutable, 3 cardinal, 3 fixed by mode. A fire emphasis is read as appetite for the first move, with information gathered by doing rather than before doing. Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Taurus into Gemini during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.9° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
